# Federated Vector DBs

[⬅ Back to the full list](../README.md) · 1 item · [Browse on the website](https://vectordb.ever.works)

- [Swirl](https://swirlaiconnect.com/) - Open-source federated search platform for privacy-preserving vector similarity search across distributed enterprise data sources without data migration or central storage, unlike centralized vector DBs like Pinecone that require uploading all data to a single service. Enables multi-node federation querying 100+ heterogeneous sources simultaneously, using LLM embeddings for re-ranking unified results while keeping data local for enhanced privacy and compliance. Ideal for federated learning scenarios and data-sovereign AI applications. ([Read more](../details/swirl-metasearch.md)) `Federated Search` `Open Source` `Enterprise` `Privacy Focused` `Distributed`
